'''Star Tours Flight 124''' was the designation of a flight to [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] offered to passengers by the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency around the time of the [[Battle of Death Star III]]. The flight had begun boarding at Gate 8 at the time.
